<function name="SetGlobal2Vector" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Defines a vector to be automatically networked to clients

<note>Running this function clientside will only set it clientside for the client it is called on!</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="index" type="any">Index to identify the global vector with</arg>
		<arg name="vec" type="Vector">Vector to be networked</arg>
	</args>
</function>
